articles.title: ‘Bright lights don’t bug him’ | After nearly winning NCAA championship, Zelenov ready for big sophomore campaign
Desharnais out 4-6 weeks for Capitals after appendectomy
Kulich exits, Sabres make tweaks ahead of week-long road trip

out.detail: upper body injury; took puck to face, did not travel to Washington

away.summary: The Sabres (4-4-2) head to Washington on a four-game road trip after a 3-1 home loss to Philadelphia. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen is projected to start in net, with Colten Ellis as backup. Buffalo is missing several key players, including Jiri Kulich (upper body), Justin Danforth, Sam Carrick, Matt Grzelcyk, Alex Lyon, and Conor Timmins, with Dennis Gilbert scratched.

out.detail: appendectomy; out 4-6 weeks, placed on injured reserve

doubtful.detail: day-to-day; lower body injury, game-time decision
illness; returned to practice, status for game uncertain

home.summary: The Capitals (5-4-0) host Buffalo after a 5-2 loss to Los Angeles. Charlie Lindgren is projected to start with Mitch Gibson backing him up, as Logan Thompson is day-to-day with a lower-body injury. Vincent Desharnais is out 4-6 weeks after an appendectomy, while Pierre-Luc Dubois and Justin Sourdif are returning from illness and were full practice participants.
